Finite numerical checker for q=1..249 is supplementary only.

value.rationale: Four consecutive spatial sites are the first next-order exact Fourier sampling problem beyond the known three-site case. On even cyclic orders not divisible by four, the naïve four-equally-spaced quadrature is unavailable. This infinite arithmetic family now has an exact shortest possible bandwidth together with constructive positive weights and endpoint occupation, a natural sampling invariant rather than a one-off tabulation. It does not rely on an unproved claim for odd orders.
